Validate a databook against its codebook rules

Source: R/validate_data_by_codebook.R
validateDatabook.Rd

Applies the validation rules defined in the codebook to the databook$data data frame using pointblank. Also checks that all source_id values exist in the id_mapping table (unless the codebook is id_mapping itself).

Usage

validateDatabook(databook, print = TRUE, con = NULL)

Arguments

databook

A databook list as produced by codebookToEntries(), containing $data, $codebook, and $codebook_name.

print

Logical. If TRUE (default), prints the pointblank agent report to the console.

con

A DBI connection. If NULL, the default connection set by FAIRgroundConnect() is used.

Value

A list with two elements:

  • $status: 1 if all validations passed, 0 if any failed.

  • $summary: the interrogated pointblank agent object.

See also

codebookToEntries()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  databook <- codebookToEntries("participant", nrow = 0)
  result <- validateDatabook(databook, print = FALSE)
} # }
